title: UGC NET June 2024 Certificate
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ugcnet.nta.nic.in
2. Open e-Certificate download
3. Enter June 2024 application number and DOB
4. Download PDF certificate
5. Check DigiLocker for linked document
shortDescription: UGC NET June 2024 Certificate download for JRF / Assistant Professor qualified candidates via NTA portal.
content:
UGC NET June 2024 e-certificates are available on the NTA UGC NET portal for candidates who qualified.

Download and preserve the certificate number. Validity and category (JRF only / Assistant Professor / both) are printed on the e-certificate.
